title: deep-review S1: deterministic gate enforcement at mutation seams + atomic close_task tool
description: Deep-review confirmed finding (2026-07-02), the central bet of the unattended pivot: all five loop gates and the uat-only done-gate are 100 percent prose - transitionStatus and the MCP transition_status tool check nothing, and the per-ticket close-out (the most frequent write of the workflow: status + comment + linked_commits + linked_prs + index) is done with ~6 manual Edits bypassing the validation/atomicity the store already provides. In a long unattended run the only thing between the loop and an unauthorized close/push is model memory of loop.md prose - exactly what context compaction erodes. Coordinate with TASK-075 (its grant mechanism is the un-enforced half of this).
acceptance_criteria: transitionStatus (and the MCP transition_status tool) throws a clear typed error when a task with verification_tier uat-only transitions to done without a comments[] entry whose author is uat; spec covers both the store function and the MCP surface.

Loop-mode close guard: when the active bundle mode is loop, close-to-done additionally requires loop_auth.auto_close_on_green_review - implemented at the MCP/command layer or as an injectable policy hook so task-store does not hard-couple to bundle internals; placement documented.

A close_task MCP tool applies transition + summary comment + linked_commits + linked_prs + index regen in ONE validate-then-atomic pass; orchestrator-routing SKILL.md (both copies) routes all ticket writes through the MCP tools with Edit as a documented fallback only.
Push guard: a documented PreToolUse/pre-push hook recipe blocks git push while mode is loop unless loop_auth.auto_push_after_close is true; recipe shipped in loop.md or settings docs.
tdd: failing tests first for the uat-only done-guard, the loop-mode close guard, and close_task atomicity (all-or-nothing on failure).

Review PASS 0H/2M/3L; the 2 MEDIUMs (missing locks for guard self-satisfaction and close_task-under-loop composition) + 2 LOW doc fixes landed in-band as 88222a3 with plant-proven locks, cold re-verified PASS. Gates: test:all 1018/4 green, fast tier 510/2, test:since non-zero. THIS CLOSE ITSELF ran through the new closeTask export with loopModeCloseGuard composed (harness mode, guard no-op) - first production dogfood.
